## 36008ff86ada

**Reproduced distribution/override defect.** Audited source SHA-256:
`559da543400c23668e795f1738ac40e0363b55963f3257e946ddf31277fa99d3`.
All three canonical inputs have height 6 (`6x6`, `6x7`, `6x7`), and the public
axis advertises `grid_h: 6..12`. Nevertheless, a source-bound census generated
30,000 ordinary inputs across easy/medium/hard with **0 height-6 hits** and
**0 exact canonical-shape hits**. The same source rejected every one of 12
advertised boundary probes: `grid_h=6`, `grid_w=6`, `n_markers=4`, and the joint
`grid_h=12, grid_w=12, n_markers=4` request in each difficulty band. Typical
errors are `draw_int('grid_h'): override 6 outside [7, 8]` and
`draw_int('n_markers'): override 4 outside [1, 3]`.

Reproducer and full histograms:
`checks/audit/36008ff86ada/canonical_profile_override_probe.py` and
`checks/audit/36008ff86ada/report.json`.

Suggested repair: include a scheduled canonical-size profile, make explicit
axis overrides bypass difficulty defaults while retaining the declared global
validity bounds, and remove or declare any controls that cannot be honored.
This audit did not evaluate every possible stamping shortcut or propose a rule
change; it establishes a source-bound support/contract mismatch.
